description: Byte sequence written byte-by-byte by the Amiga
Host writes the upper lane (h_be=10) then the lower lane (h_be=01)
Amiga writes the even byte then the odd byte
Walking one: word k = 1 << k (k = 0..15), detects a byte-lane swap
Queue slot header: seq $1234, type $0001, flags $8001 (OWN + bit 0), len $0010
32-bit counter $DEADBEEF written with MOVE.L (two Zorro cycles, high word first)
